item: A repaired row exports as inherited only while it follows the imported attempt; unreadable run records are named in the export (diagnostics rank 14, from the Opus review of #1288)
status: SHIPPED (field effect at each instance's next export)
summary: A row withdrawn by the boot repair that this install later disqualified again (a local disqualification stamps no criteria version) still exported as inherited; the export now compares the row's newest judging attempt with the one the repair followed (repaired_rows returns judged_at per domain), so a later local judgement in either direction reads measured. An unreadable run record made its rows ship as measured with nothing said; the basis block now sets repair_record_unreadable and names the runs (repair_runs_unreadable). An unreadable newest run at an unchanged clock is no longer overwritten. OPEN_QUEUE records the two readings of a repaired row and the one audit record that can still be lost. Three tests, each failing when its fix is removed.
